[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Lisa Mandrake''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] military. Mandrake led the ten-being security team assigned to [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DP" />
